text:
Priya (Product): Dropping a thread about the setup wizard host probe UX. Main decision points: list density, failure language, retry affordances, and accessibility behavior. Figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder (frame 'Probe UX - v2')

Evan (Design): My initial take: compact rows for scale, but include an inline expander that reveals a small card with command snippets and one-click actions. Avoid full modals for logs.

Ruth (Accessibility): Agree on rows + expand. Accessibility rules: expanded rows need aria-expanded, keyboard focus must move into the expanded area, and the summary should be announced only at completion. Use non-color indicators (icons + text).

Diego (Infra): Tech caveat: probes are rate-limited on some on-prem appliances. We should surface a retry cooldown and limit auto-retries to avoid triggering device protections. Also include 'last tried' timestamp per host.

Priya (Product): For copy, thinking of softer failure language. Options: 'Unreachable' vs "Can't reach host" vs 'No response'. Which reads clearer to customers?

Evan (Design): Lean toward "Can't reach host" in-row, and show a slightly more diagnostic label in the detail (e.g., 'No response (timeout)'). Keeps the row concise and the details explicit.

Ruth (Accessibility): Microcopy note: avoid technical acronyms in the status pill. Use plain language in the row and offer an explanation link 'Why this failed' that opens the KB. Make sure that link is keyboard accessible and announced.

Diego (Infra): For retries: implement per-host retry buttons (icon + 'Retry probe') with an inline spinner. For bulk operations, hide 'Retry all failed' in a dropdown with confirmation and explain cooldown risk. Server will return a retry-allowed flag; reflect that state in the UI.

Priya (Product): UX for errors: show a collapsed error card under the host row with three lines: 1) short cause, 2) one actionable command (copyable), 3) a 'Retry probe' button + small 'Contact support' link. Example command: ```nc -vz 10.0.4.5 8800``` note: 'run from a host in same VPC'.

Evan (Design): Visual tone: avoid loud full-screen red. Use a top-line summary: 'Checks complete  7 reachable, 2 need attention' with amber icon when partial failures. If user filters to 'Failures only' show cards.

Ruth (Accessibility): Announcements: only read the final summary (polite) and when the user triggers a retry outcome. Do not announce each intermediate host status to avoid verbosity. Also ensure the copy button has aria-label 'Copy command for <host>'.

Diego (Infra): Also add a tiny 'raw output' collapsed section for SREs with copyable logs. Keep it collapsed by default to reduce noise. Server will provide logs; show them with monospaced wrap and a copy button.

Priya (Product): Edge case: flaky networks causing repeated immediate retries. Proposal: exponential backoff with client-side cap (max 3 attempts) and show 'Retry disabled  try again in 35s' in tooltip and inline text. Any objections?

Evan (Design): No objections. For the cooldown UI show a small countdown next to the retry button and gray out the button. Also include a tooltip 'Backoff in effect to avoid device rate limits'.

Ruth (Accessibility): Ensure the countdown is announced when it appears: 'Retry disabled for 35 seconds'. Use aria-live for that single announcement. Keep updates to a small cadence, not every second.

qa-bot: preview build ready -> https://deploy/preview/9012 (staging)

Diego (Infra): QA note: please include a test case with 6 hosts where 2 fail and one flaps between reachable/unreachable to validate focus and live region behavior.

Priya (Product): Action items: Evan to update mocks with compact rows + expand-to-card, inline copyable commands, retry cooldown UI, and neutral summary tone. Ruth to write the accessibility checklist. Diego will add a server flag for retry-allowed and raw logs. I'll follow up with updated figma + preview. Thanks all!
